name: AgentDisc
description: Discord in the browser, set up for working with agents: typing dots on threads, panel switches and themes. Built on Vencord (GPL-3.0).
author: Stephane Franceschini, built on Vencord by Vendicated

TOGGLE_MUTE.description: Toggle Mute — Toggle your microphone's transmission on and off.

TOGGLE_DEAFEN.description: Toggle Deafen — Toggle your speaker's playback on and off. Also disables your microphone while deafened.

TOGGLE_VOICE_MODE.description: Toggle VAD — Toggle to switch between Push-to-talk and Voice Activity mode.

TOGGLE_STREAMER_MODE.description: Toggle Streamer Mode — Toggle to enable/disable Streamer Mode.

TOGGLE_GO_LIVE_STREAMING.description: Toggle Screen Share — Toggle to start/stop streaming in your current voice channel. Streams can only be started with this keybind if Discord recognises the game you are currently playing.

NAVIGATE_BACK.description: Navigate Back — Might conflict with your browsers native keybinds

NAVIGATE_FORWARD.description: Navigate Forward — Might conflict with your browsers native keybinds

SAVE_CLIP.description: Save Clip — Clips the last 30 seconds to 2 minutes of your stream, depending on your settings.
